name: Bamyan Valley
description: Bamyan Valley is renowned for its dramatic sandstone cliffs, ancient cave complexes, and rich Buddhist heritage.

name: Band-e-Amir National Park
description: Afghanistan's first national park, Band-e-Amir is famous for six deep-blue lakes separated by natural travertine dams.

name: Berat Old Town (Mangalem & Gorica)
description: Known as the City of a Thousand Windows, Berat is famous for Ottoman-era houses and hillside neighbourhoods.
